core_memory.osteoarthritis_management: Osteoarthritis: Acetaminophen as needed for mild pain. Meloxicam 7.5mg as needed(not daily) for flare-ups. Avoid NSAID overuse. Glucosamine supplements tried, effectiveness uncertain.
core_memory.vitamin_d_and_calcium_management: Vitamin D3 2000 IU daily for low levels(22 ng/mL). Calcium supplements for osteopenia. Combined with vitamin K2 for absorption.
core_memory.statin_management: Statin: Atorvastatin 10mg daily. LDL 130 mg/dL → improving. Triglycerides 140 mg/dL. No side effects reported.
core_memory.general_health_supplements: General health: Multivitamin, omega-3 for heart health, probiotics for digestion. Digestive enzymes post-gallbladder removal. Mindful of fatty foods.
core_memory.medication_interactions: Losartan + meloxicam: NSAIDs may affect kidney function; avoid frequent use. Thyroid medication separated from calcium/iron to prevent absorption interference.
core_memory.health_management_overview: Using pill planner and phone reminders for organization. Prioritize lifestyle changes to reduce medication reliance. Aim for natural health management where possible.
